name: 32137 · Palm Coast, FL
findings: ZIP 32137 (Palm Coast) has 130 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32137 (Palm Coast) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32137 (Palm Coast) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32137 (Palm Coast) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
